content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 14.1 (p0121) is a mutual assignment restriction with an M&A/asset-sale carve-out, and no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists anywhere (Section 11 triggers are limited to uncured material breach and insolvency) — so no walk-away issue. It nonetheless falls short of the fallback because consent for all other assignments, including to a Corio affiliate, is unqualified and absolute. The redline adds a "not unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed" standard plus an affiliate carve-out for Corio, leaving the negotiated mutual merger carve-out and competitor exception untouched.
